shrail-grappler: Enemies cannot move when they are adjacent to you and this ability is active. When you move, they move with you. If a character cannot move with you, they are not moved.
shrail-masochism: When you drop below 100%, 75%, 50%, or 25% HP, you gain haste for 10 turns. Thresholds can retrigger after healing. Crossing multiple thresholds in one hit grants 10 total turns of haste.
pelian-fated-duel: When activated, select an adjacent enemy. Create a 5x5 square around that enemy. Until you leave that area, no other enemy can attack you. This costs 3 energy per turn to keep active.
isheilah-missed-me: Gain one maximum reaction. Reactions refresh when you wait. When active, if you have a reaction and an enemy would attack you in melee, you instead move one tile away from them and spend a reaction. If no legal retreat square exists, the ability fails and does not spend a reaction.
kative-cogworks:
This ability can be toggled to mode one, two or three, or activated.

Mode 1: When activated, create a 3x3 pit in an area not occupied by any creatures. Costs 20 energy.

Mode 2: When activated, create a 5x1 wall with 200 HP, oriented perpendicular to the direction thrown. Costs 20 energy.

Mode 3: Select a terrain modification you have made and remove it. Removing a terrain modification is free.

Implementation: Preview the placement in the sight display; color both the pit and wall in Kative's colors. When an enemy tries to move through a wall, it attacks the wall instead.
kative-mini-me: Activate for 30 energy to create a copy with your current stats, but no abilities. This version of you is a perfect ally. Deactivating kills this creature.
kative-tinker: Spend 100 energy to bless a ring or amulet with a random ability from a random god you do not embody. The ring or amulet retains its existing abilities as well as the new ability. The granted ability works while the item is carried; all carried rings and amulets are automatically active. Each item can be tinkered once; granted abilities never duplicate another generated item grant.
kative-clay-army:
When activated, spend 20 energy and move one tile. Where you were standing becomes a Clay Soldier which will attack anyone who is adjacent to it at the end of a turn. A Clay Soldier copies your current attacks without abilities.

Implementation: Clay Soldiers are treated as unbreakable walls for pathfinding and collision.
kative-appropriate: Increase the number of rings you can carry by 3 and the number of amulets you can carry by 3. Reduce energy costs from amulets by 10.
pelian-i-came-for-you: Spend 10 energy and select an enemy. You gain telepathy on that enemy and if a move would bring you closer to the enemy, you can take 1 free turn afterward.
numo-mind-read: While active, spend 1 energy per turn and you have telepathy within 20. While inactive, you have telepathy within 5. The first turn is paid immediately on activation.
ursa-dream-see: You have telepathy with sleeping creatures. When active, spend 1 energy per turn and you have telepathy with all creatures that are not obstructed. The first turn is paid immediately on activation.
morae-bonded-by-unseen-threads: Spend 15 energy on activation and select an enemy. When you take damage, they take half. Spend 8 energy per turn to keep active, with the first turn paid immediately on activation.
